title: 5BR Home in Rosemary Beach with Private Beach Access
meta_description: Relax at Joben Cottage, a 5BR, 4.5BA home in Rosemary Beach, FL, with private beach access, a gourmet kitchen, and 4 community pools. Sleeps 15.
description_expanded: DescriptionA gracious and graceful southern home located just steps from the warm Gulf of Mexico shore, Joben Cottage has space for the whole family to spread out and relax. With six bedrooms and five bathrooms, even large groups will be completely comfy here. Surrounded by ample porches, wooden boardwalks, and Adirondack chairs, Joben Cottage features a chic, remodeled vibe with a laid-back, luxurious style. Park in the garage and walk or bike everywhere from here— vacation starts now.The main level of Joben Cottage is open and airy, with sky-high ceilings and lots of creamy, neutral tones. In the living area, there’s a plush sofa and four overstuffed armchairs surrounding the large HDTV. Overhead, the ceilings are finished in natural wood tones, and in the corner, there’s a cozy fireplace flanked by huge glass doors that allow the natural sunshine inside. A pleasing mix of classic finishes and modern artwork create a chic space to kick back and recharge.Around the corner lies the large, gourmet kitchen that’s ideal for preparing homemade meals or simply heating up leftovers from a nearby cafe. Custom sea glass-colored cabinets are topped with gleaming granite countertops. Premier appliances include a double wall oven, gas range, dishwasher, and a SubZero refrigerator, as well as a porcelain farmhouse sink. There’s seating at the peninsula bar as well as the formal dining table nearby.The first bedroom suite is located on the main level and features a king-size four-poster bed, HDTV, a walk-in closet, and an ensuite bathroom with a soaking tub, double vanities, and a step-in shower. Upstairs on the second level, another bedroom suite includes a king-size bed, fireplace, HDTV, kitchenette, ensuite bathroom, and doors leading out to the balcony.A third bedroom is a custom bunk room with two built-in, twin-over-twin size bunks and an HDTV. The fourth bedroom includes a twin-size bed over a twin-sized trundle, and the fifth bedroom has a queen-size bed and a full ensuite bathroom. Stairs lead up to the third floor and an open, loft-style space with birds-eye views of the neighborhood that also doubles as a sitting area, office, or flexible sleeping space.Inspired by elegant southern homes of the French Quarter, Joben Cottage is surrounded by generous covered porches that are accessible from nearly every room. Your whole group will love serving up cool drinks and relaxing on the veranda while watching the world go by. There’s also an alfresco dining area with an outdoor dining space and a gas grill, as well as an outdoor shower for rinsing off sandy toes. And when it’s time to hit the beach, grab a casual lunch, or indulge in a romantic date night out, you’re only a few steps away from nearly everything Rosemary Beach has to offer.COMMUNITY AMENITIES:• 4 Community Pools (1 heated) Short Walk to Barbados or Coquina Pool• Private Beach Access• Spa offering a wide variety of services including massage therapy, facials, nail services, and refreshing body treatments• Fitness Center with top-of-the-line Equipment and Certified Personal Training (Membership Fees Apply)• Tennis Courts (Court Rental Fees Apply)• Short walk to Shopping and DiningHOME HIGHLIGHTS:Professionally designedQuick walk to the beach High-speed Wifi 6 Mesh NetworkSonos Sound System4 Complimentary Beach Cruiser BikesClean Bedding ProgramGROUND LEVEL:LIVING AREA w/ HDTV & FireplaceOpen KITCHEN w/ eat-in spacePRIMARY SUITE w/ king-size bed and jetted tub and walk-in shower ENSUITE BATHROOM (Sleeps 2)HALF BATHROOMOUTDOOR DINING and LOUNGING SPACESECOND FLOOR:BEDROOM SUITE w/ king-size bed and shower/tub combination ENSUITE BATHROOM (Sleeps 2)BEDROOM w/ twin-size bed over a trundled twin bed and walk-in shower ENSUITE BATHROOM (Sleeps 2)BEDROOM w/ queen-size bed and shower/tub combination ENSUITE BATHROOM (Sleeps 2)BUNK ROOM w/ 2 twin-over-twin custom bunks (Sleeps 4)THIRD FLOOR:OPEN LOFT SPACE w/ 3 Trundle Twin Beds (Sleeps 3)
